founder.title: Founded by Pablo Romano.
founder.bio1: gemm-apps was born when Gemma was born.
founder.bio2: Becoming a parent changes your perspective on everything, including how you want to work. I started thinking about how much time gets wasted on tasks that a machine should handle.
founder.bio3: So I decided to build the tools that give that time back. For me. And for the businesses that think the same way.
